body:
Dewdrop makes 20.9 million abstract-array casts immediately followed by `array.len`. Resolve and check the object once in a shared noncollecting AMD64 leaf, then read its length. Preserve the original Go paths for null, invalid values, and legacy subtype metadata.

Array kind uses one bit in the existing DFS entry timestamp. An encoding marker uses the existing native-view padding word; ABI version 9, view size, handle layout, object layout, and per-type table size stay unchanged. Existing interval comparisons retain their ordering. Lean TinyGo keeps its prior path. Astra reviewed the invariants before implementation.

Performance against the installed combined GC stack:
- Cast/length loop: 686.6 µs → 33.65 µs per 8,192 iterations (20.4×).
- Mixed allocation loop: 762.5 µs → 104.6 µs (7.29×).
- Four serial full Dewdrop runs, control/candidate/candidate/control, identical CPU affinity and fresh caches: control 49.893/49.134 s; candidate 47.190/47.832 s. Median falls 4.04%. All output hashes match, Wasm validates, and main returns 42. V8 parity is not reached.

Validation: full normal suite passes; checked compiler/collector/API packages pass. One unrelated plugin-install test hit transient ETXTBSY in the full checked run; its complete package passes on rerun. Checked benchmark-module tests pass. Focused codegen/register checks, forced-GC/Tiny profiles, 24 live locals, null/type/foreign traps, legacy timestamps, ARM64 interval tests under QEMU, and saved-code execution on old/new ABI-9 runtimes pass. Docs pass. Research notes and raw measurements are included.

Safety follow-ups: runtime AddTypes now preserves the array-kind encoding when independent root types are appended (regression fails before the repair). The cast/length matcher also respects WAGO_AMD64_NO_GC_SHARED_STUBS=1 before consuming opcodes. Both cast nullabilities are tested with the switch enabled/disabled; disabled mode emits zero shared stubs and calls. Normal and checked focused backend/collector/runtime tests pass. Default-mode generated code and measured performance are unchanged by the switch guard.
Further safety fix: validate the physical object span before reading its type ID in the Go fallback. Malformed handle spaces and short/overflowing extents now return the existing diagnostic instead of panicking. Regressions cover all 252 invalid space bytes, moved survivors, old/large/Tiny heaps, adjacent metadata bytes, and fresh/saved code.

A separate follow-up replaces this leaf's 32-bit space decode with a single byte load, retaining every check and fallback. The isolated 8,192-iteration length benchmark is 2.99% faster; the allocating benchmark has no clear gain. No full-job gain is claimed for this decoder alone. Complete normal/checked root suites and checked benchmark-module tests pass. Raw failures, samples, hashes and final checks are in docs/research/abstract-array-cast-length-results.

title: perf(amd64): combine abstract array casts and length reads
